user.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 1
user.description:
Please connect your PlayStation controller (DualShock/DualSense) to the Home Assistant server via USB, then click Submit to extract the MAC addresses.

{status}

select_controller.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth — Controller Selection
select_controller.description: **{count} PlayStation controllers detected.** Select the one you want to configure.

select_wake_method.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 2
select_wake_method.description:
Detected: **ESPHome** — {esp_summary} | **Bluetooth** — {adapter_summary}

Choose how this console should be woken up.

select_esp.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 3 (ESPHome)
select_esp.description: Select the ESPHome node that will be used to wake this console.

select_esp_warning.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 3 (ESPHome)
select_esp_warning.description:
⚠️ **Warning: No compatible ESPHome node found.**

You can leave this field empty to finish the installation and link the node later via the Configure menu.

select_dongle.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 3 (Bluetooth Dongle)
select_dongle.description: Select a compatible local Bluetooth adapter that will send wake packets directly.

select_dongle_warning.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 3 (Bluetooth Dongle)
select_dongle_warning.description:
⚠️ **Warning: No compatible adapter could be auto-detected.**

Enter the adapter manually using the format `hciX` (example: `hci0`).

select_csr_write_mode.title: Wake PSX on Bluetooth - Step 4 (CSR Dongle)
select_csr_write_mode.description:
CSR adapter detected. Choose how the BD_ADDR is written before each wake command.

- **Transient (recommended):** written to RAM only. The software always restores the original address after use. If the process crashes, simply unplugging and replugging the dongle recovers it automatically.
- **Persistent:** written to flash. The software still restores after use, but if the process crashes, the flash retains the wrong address until the next run.

error.no_controller: No compatible PlayStation controller found on USB. Please reconnect and try again.
error.extraction_error: An error occurred while reading the USB device. Check your system logs.
error.invalid_adapter: Invalid Bluetooth adapter format. Use hciX (example: hci0).
error.adapter_already_configured: The selected Bluetooth adapter is already configured for another console.
error.adapter_not_found: The selected Bluetooth adapter was not detected on this system.
error.detection_error: Failed to detect the adapter strategy. Check that the adapter is connected and that Home Assistant has access to Bluetooth devices.
error.no_esphome_found: No compatible ESPHome node found. Make sure a node running the WakePSX firmware is online and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.no_adapter_found: No Bluetooth adapter detected on this system. Please connect a USB Bluetooth dongle and try again.

abort.extraction_error: An internal error occurred during configuration. Please restart the setup.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The console configuration has been updated successfully.

init.title: Reconfigure Wake Method
init.description:
Detected: **ESPHome** — {esp_summary} | **Bluetooth** — {adapter_summary}

Select which wake method should be used for this console.

init_esphome.title: Reconfigure ESP Node
init_esphome.description: Select the ESPHome node used for wake commands.

init_esphome_warning.title: Reconfigure ESP Node
init_esphome_warning.description:
⚠️ **Warning: No compatible ESPHome node found.**

You can leave this field empty to finish the configuration and link the node later via the Configure menu.

init_dongle.title: Reconfigure Bluetooth Dongle
init_dongle.description: Select the local Bluetooth adapter used for direct wake commands.

init_dongle_warning.title: Reconfigure Bluetooth Dongle
init_dongle_warning.description:
⚠️ **Warning: No compatible adapter could be auto-detected.**

Enter the adapter manually using the format `hciX` (example: `hci0`).

init_csr_write_mode.title: Reconfigure CSR Write Mode
init_csr_write_mode.description:
Choose how the CSR adapter writes the BD_ADDR before each wake command.

- **Transient (recommended):** written to RAM only. The software always restores the original address after use. If the process crashes, simply unplugging and replugging the dongle recovers it automatically.
- **Persistent:** written to flash. The software still restores after use, but if the process crashes, the flash retains the wrong address until the next run.
